subject: Background and a question
body: Hello, I hope you are well. I wanted to give you some background first. I studied business administration at university and then spent two years in retail sales, where I learned a lot about customers and about working under pressure. After that I moved into a coordinator role at a small logistics company, where I ended up doing a lot of onboarding for new hires, organising training days, keeping employee records up to date and helping our manager with interviews. Honestly I enjoyed that part much more than the sales side. When I saw the Sales Associate opening at Brightpath I applied because I really like what your company does and I thought any role would be a good way in. But since then I noticed you also have an HR Coordinator opening, which matches my recent experience much better. I don't want to seem indecisive and I am still happy to be considered for sales if that is the only option. I also wasn't sure whether applying twice would look bad, or whether my existing application could simply be moved. My manager has agreed to give a reference whenever needed. Anyway, sorry for the long message, I just wanted to explain my thinking properly. Thank you for reading.
